generation.prompt: Repaint reference1 into an opaque clean hand-painted HD RPG tile atlas. EXACT1024x1536 pixels,8 columns12 rows of128px squares. This is a source atlas; keep EVERY source shape at the EXACT same coordinates, size, colors and orientation, preserving cutoffs at cell boundaries. No gutters, gridlines, cell borders, reordering or recentering. Paint the complete cells, including original green regions and ALL visible objects; do not erase an object merely because it is green. Preserve flat olive/dark green ground with broad soft painterly strokes; restrained texture, no new grass blades, flowers, bushes or scenery. Smooth source pixel stair steps while keeping source contour positions and topology. No new symbols, labels, people, writing or inferred details. Black source openings remain black; flat blue regions remain flat blue. Reference2/3 ONLY provide brush style, never add their objects or colors. Preserve the blue water gaps and brown banks, pale blocky stone diagonals, blue/red and olive vertical rounded forms with small brown bases, low blue-gray strip patterns and dark rectangular hatch patterns, open/closed blue or pale-rim rectangular containers, green-topped brown cliff/bank boundaries, large dark cutouts, and red/buff pointed forms.
